name: Button Text Changer for WooCommerce
author: khizerqureshi

sections.description:
Button Text Changer for WooCommerce lets you customize commonly used WooCommerce button labels directly from the WordPress admin area.

The plugin provides a simple settings interface for changing button text while keeping your customizations separate from your theme files.

You can customize commonly used WooCommerce button labels such as Add to Cart, View Cart, Update Cart, Proceed to Checkout, Place Order, and Read More.

The plugin also provides Save and Reset options so you can easily apply or restore your button text settings.

It is designed to work with WooCommerce websites and is compatible with Elementor-based websites.

Features

  • Customize the Add to Cart button text.
  • Customize the View Cart button text.
  • Customize the Update Cart button text.
  • Customize the Proceed to Checkout button text.
  • Customize the Place Order button text.
  • Customize the Read More button text.
  • Enable or disable global button text changes.
  • Save customized button text from the WordPress admin.
  • Reset button text settings to their default values.
  • No need to edit WooCommerce template files.
  • No need to modify active theme files.
  • Works with WooCommerce hooks.
  • Compatible with Elementor-based WooCommerce websites.
  • Lightweight and easy to configure.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher.
  • WooCommerce.
  • PHP 7.4 or higher.
  • Elementor is optional and is not required for the core button text functionality.
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  2. Upload the button-text-changer-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Alternatively, install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  4. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  5. Open the Button Text Changer for WooCommerce settings from the WooCommerce admin menu.
  6. Enter your preferred button text.
  7. Click the Save Button Settings button to apply your changes.
  8. Use the Reset Settings option to restore the default button text when required.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated for the plugin’s button text customization features to work.

Can I change the Add to Cart button text?

Yes. The plugin allows you to customize the WooCommerce Add to Cart button text.

Can I change the View Cart button text?

Yes. The plugin allows you to customize the WooCommerce View Cart button text.

Can I change the Update Cart button text?

Yes. The plugin allows you to customize the WooCommerce Update Cart button text.

Can I change the Proceed to Checkout button text?

Yes. The plugin allows you to customize the WooCommerce Proceed to Checkout button text.

Can I change the Place Order button text?

Yes. The plugin allows you to customize the WooCommerce Place Order button text.

Can I change the Read More button text?

Yes. The plugin allows you to customize the WooCommerce Read More button text.

Do I need to edit my theme files?

No. The plugin uses WooCommerce functionality to customize supported button labels without requiring you to modify your theme or WooCommerce template files.

Can I reset my customized button text?

Yes. Use the Reset Settings option in the plugin settings to restore the default button text.

Is Elementor required?

No. Elementor is optional. The core WooCommerce button text functionality does not require Elementor.

Will my settings remain after changing my theme?

The plugin stores its settings independently of the active theme, so your configured button text is not directly dependent on your theme files.
